entities.summary: Tigran Gharamian (b. 1984-07-24, Yerevan) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yerevan and Armenia. Known in the fields of armenia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
